source.title: PA DEP drinking-water microbiology accreditation report, 13 June 2024
limitations: This PDF lists laboratories accredited for drinking-water bacteriology (total coliform / E. coli). It is not a private-well-owner directory.

Municipal water-treatment-plant laboratories, wastewater laboratories, bottling plants, veterinary clinics, and pool shops were omitted because they typically do not accept samples from private well owners. That omission is a directory choice, not a statement about their accreditation.
Except for Penn State Agricultural Analytical Services Laboratory, Well Labs Index has not independently verified that these laboratories currently accept private-well samples.
The report is dated 13 June 2024. Accreditation can change. Confirm with the laboratory and with PA DEP Search Accredited Environmental Laboratories.
Chemical contaminant accreditation is a separate field of accreditation. Use the DEP search tool for metals, VOCs, and other analytes.

labs.name: Agricultural Analytical Services Laboratory (Penn State)
labs.sample_dropoff_or_mail: mail-in kit (lab or county Extension); drop-off unknown
labs.accreditation_listed: Drinking-water total coliform and/or E. coli (DEP microbiology accreditation report, 13 June 2024). Chemical accreditation is not listed on this page — confirm with the lab or the DEP search tool.
labs.notes: Penn State College of Agricultural Sciences public drinking-water program. DEP record lists the lab as 111 Ag Analytical Srvcs Lab, University Park, PA 16802. Kits available from the lab or participating county Penn State Extension offices. Mail-in cooler kits. Does not provide chain-of-custody testing. Hours listed by Penn State: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM. Email listed by Penn State: aaslab@psu.edu.
labs.source_document: PA DEP drinking-water microbiology accreditation report, 13 June 2024
